notes.title: Cosmic Arcade Tycoon Playtest Timeline and Information
notes.notes:
[u][b]Welcome to the Cosmic Arcade Tycoon Playtest![/b][/u]

The playtest is now public and will run until the [b]following date[/b]: 

- Central European Time (CET, UTC+1): 9 PM Tuesday
- Eastern Standard Time (EST, UTC-5): 3 PM Tuesday
- Central Standard Time (CST, UTC-6): 2 PM Tuesday
- Mountain Standard Time (MST, UTC-7): 1 PM Tuesday
- Pacific Standard Time (PST, UTC-8): 12 PM (noon) Tuesday

Thank you for trying out the game. Your feedback is crucial to making it the best it can be.

As you play, take notes on anything that feels unclear, unbalanced, or buggy. The game is in active development, so expect inconsistencies. Your thoughts on gameplay, UI, or overall experience will help us improve.

Don’t forget to share your feedback via Instagram, Discord, or the Google form linked in the bottom right of the main menu.

[b]The game can also be played on Steam Deck![/b]

Your input makes a difference. Thank you for being part of this journey and make sure to wishlist the game to get notified on its release!
